title: Basic Card Layout
spec: Create a page with a single 'card' div. Inside the card, have an 'h2' with text 'Card Title' and a 'p' with text 'This is the card content.'. The card should have a background color of #F0F0F0, a padding of 15px, and a border-radius of 8px. The h2 should be #333333 and the p should be #666666.

title: Alert Message Box
spec: Design an 'alert' div containing a 'span' for an icon (e.g., '⚠') and a 'p' for the message 'Warning: Something went wrong.'. The alert box should have a background of #FFF3CD, a border of 1px solid #FFECB3, padding of 10px, and text color #856404. The span should be bold.

title: Navigation Bar
spec: Create a 'nav' element with a 'ul' inside. The ul should contain three 'li' elements, each with an 'a' link ('Home', 'About', 'Contact'). The nav should have a background of #333333. The li elements should display inline, and the a links should be #FFFFFF, have no underline, and 10px padding.

title: Simple Button Style
spec: Add a 'button' element with the text 'Click Me'. The button should have a background of #007BFF, text color #FFFFFF, padding of 10px 20px, a border-radius of 5px, and no border. On hover, the background should change to #0056b3.

title: Profile Header
spec: Create a 'profile-header' div. Inside, include an 'img' (e.g., placeholder.png) with class 'profile-pic' and an 'h1' with text 'John Doe'. The profile-header should be centered with a max-width of 300px. The image should be a circle (border-radius 50%) with a 2px solid #DDDDDD border. The h1 should be #333333 and centered.

title: Pricing Table Item
spec: Design a 'pricing-item' div. Inside, include an 'h3' (Plan Name), a 'p' (Price: $10/month), and a 'button' (Buy Now). The pricing-item should have a border of 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding of 20px, and text-align center. The h3 should be #007BFF. The button should be similar to t004 but with a background of #28A745.

title: Image Gallery Item
spec: Create a 'gallery-item' div. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., gallery.jpg) and a 'p' (Image Caption). The gallery-item should have a border of 1px solid #CCCCCC and a padding of 5px. The image should be 100% width of its parent. The caption should be #555555 and font-size 0.9em.

title: Form Input Field
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'form-group'. Inside, a 'label' (Email:) and an 'input' of type text. The label should be #333333. The input should have a 1px solid #CCCCCC border, 8px padding, and a border-radius of 4px. On focus, the border should change to #007BFF.

title: Numbered List Styling
spec: Style an 'ol' with three 'li' items (Item 1, Item 2, Item 3). The list items should have a bottom border of 1px dotted #BBBBBB. The text color should be #444444. The list markers should be colored #007BFF.

title: Blockquote with Attribution
spec: Create a 'blockquote' with a 'p' (This is a profound quote.) and a 'footer' (— Author Name). The blockquote should have a left border of 5px solid #AAAAAA, padding of 15px, and font-style italic. The footer should be #777777 and text-align right.

title: Feature Box
spec: Design a 'feature-box' div. Inside, an 'h3' (Awesome Feature) and a 'p' (Short description of the feature.). The feature-box should have a background of #E9F5FF, padding of 20px, and a subtle box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1). The h3 should be #0056b3.

title: Call to Action Section
spec: Create a 'cta-section' div. It contains an 'h2' (Ready to Start?) and a 'button' (Get Started Now!). The cta-section should have a background of #6C757D, padding of 30px, and text-align center. The h2 should be #FFFFFF. The button should have a background #28A745 and text #FFFFFF.

title: Product Listing Item
spec: Design a 'product-item' div. Inside, an 'img' (product.jpg), an 'h4' (Product Name), and a 'span' (Price: $29.99). The product-item should have a border of 1px solid #DDDDDD, padding 10px, and text-align center. The image should be 150px wide. The span should be bold and #DC3545.

title: Team Member Card
spec: Create a 'team-member' div. Inside, an 'img' (member.jpg), an 'h3' (Jane Doe), and a 'p' (Role/Title). The team-member should have a background of #FFFFFF, border-radius 10px, box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), and text-align center. The image should be 120px circular. The h3 should be #333333.

title: Footer Section
spec: Design a 'footer' element. Inside, a 'p' (© 2023 My Website) and a 'ul' with two 'li' items (Privacy, Terms). The footer should have a background of #343A40, padding of 20px, and text-align center. The p should be #AAAAAA. The ul li should display inline and the text color should be #AAAAAA with 15px margin-right.

title: Testimonial Block
spec: Create a 'testimonial' div. Inside, a 'p' (This product is amazing!) and a 'span' (— Customer Name). The testimonial should have a background of #F8F9FA, padding of 20px, and border-left 4px solid #007BFF. The p should be italic. The span should be #666666 and text-align right.

title: Status Indicator
spec: Design a 'status-box' div. Inside, a 'span' with class 'status-icon' (e.g., '✓') and a 'p' (Status: Active). The status-box should have a border of 1px solid #28A745 and a background of #D4EDDA. The status-icon should be #28A745 and font-weight bold. The p should be #155724.

title: Article Header
spec: Create an 'article-header' div. Inside, an 'h1' (Article Title) and a 'p' (Published on: Jan 1, 2023). The article-header should have a bottom border of 1px solid #EEEEEE and padding-bottom 15px. The h1 should be #333333 and font-size 2.5em. The p should be #777777 and font-size 0.9em.

title: Interactive List Item
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'list-item'. Inside, a 'span' (Item Name) and a 'button' (Edit). The list-item should have a border-bottom 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 10px, and display flex with space-between. The button should have a background #FFC107, text #333333, and no border.

title: Hero Section with Background
spec: Design a 'hero-section' div. Inside, an 'h1' (Welcome to Our Site) and a 'p' (Your journey starts here.). The hero-section should have a background-image (e.g., url(hero-bg.jpg)), a background-size cover, min-height 300px, text-align center, and text color #FFFFFF. The h1 should be font-size 3em.

title: Progress Bar
spec: Create a 'div' with id 'progress-container'. Inside, a 'div' with id 'progress-bar'. The container should have a background #E0E0E0 and a height of 20px, border-radius 10px. The progress-bar should have a background #007BFF, a height of 100%, and a width of 50% (example value), also border-radius 10px.

title: Toggle Switch
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'toggle-switch'. Inside, a 'label' and an 'input' of type checkbox. The toggle-switch should have a specific width (e.g., 60px) and height (e.g., 34px). The label should visually represent the switch, with a background of #CCCCCC when unchecked, and #2196F3 when checked. Use pseudo-elements for the 'thumb'.

title: Dropdown Menu Item
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'dropdown-item'. Inside, an 'a' link (Menu Link). The dropdown-item should have padding 10px 15px. The 'a' should be #333333 and have no underline. On hover, the dropdown-item's background should change to #F8F9FA and the text color to #007BFF.

title: Tag/Badge Component
spec: Design a 'span' with class 'tag'. It contains text 'New Feature'. The tag should have a background of #17A2B8, text color #FFFFFF, padding 5px 10px, and a border-radius of 15px. Font-size 0.8em.

title: User Comment Block
spec: Create a 'comment-block' div. Inside, an 'h4' (User Name) and a 'p' (This is a comment.). The comment-block should have a background of #F8F8F8, border of 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, and border-radius 5px. The h4 should be #007BFF.

title: Breadcrumb Navigation
spec: Create a 'nav' with class 'breadcrumb'. Inside, a 'ul' with three 'li' items (Home, Category, Current Page), each containing an 'a' link. The li elements should display inline with a '»' separator (using pseudo-elements). The 'a' links should be #007BFF, with the last li's 'a' being #6C757D and no link decoration.

title: Pagination Link
spec: Design an 'a' element with class 'page-link' and text '1'. It should have a border of 1px solid #DDDDDD, padding 8px 12px, text color #007BFF, and no underline. On hover, the background should be #F8F9FA. For an active page, the background should be #007BFF and text color #FFFFFF.

title: Loading Spinner
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'spinner'. This div should be a circle (e.g., 50px width/height, border-radius 50%) with a 4px solid #F3F3F3 border and a 4px solid #007BFF top border. Animate it to spin indefinitely.

title: Modal Header
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'modal-header'. Inside, an 'h3' (Modal Title) and a 'button' (x). The modal-header should have a background of #F8F9FA, padding 15px, and a bottom border of 1px solid #EEEEEE. It should display flex with space-between. The button should have no background/border, font-size 1.5em, and text #AAAAAA.

title: Cookie Consent Banner
spec: Create a 'div' with id 'cookie-banner'. Inside, a 'p' (We use cookies...) and a 'button' (Accept). The banner should be fixed at the bottom of the viewport, have a background #333333, text color #FFFFFF, padding 15px, and display flex with align-items center. The button should be #28A745.

title: Image with Overlay Caption
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'image-container'. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., scenic.jpg) and a 'div' with class 'overlay' containing a 'p' (Beautiful View). The image-container should be positioned relative. The overlay should be positioned absolute, cover the image entirely, have a semi-transparent black background (rgba(0,0,0,0.6)), and center the text #FFFFFF. Initially, the overlay should be hidden and appear on hover.

title: User Avatar with Status Dot
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'avatar-wrapper'. Inside, an 'img' (user.jpg) and a 'span' with class 'status-dot'. The image should be 50px circular. The status-dot should be positioned absolute (e.g., bottom-right of avatar), a small green circle (10px, background #28A745, border-radius 50%), and border 2px solid #FFFFFF.

title: Code Snippet Block
spec: Design a 'pre' element with a 'code' element inside. The code element contains a few lines of code. The pre should have a background of #F8F8F8, border of 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, border-radius 5px, and font-family monospace. The text color should be #333333.

title: Table Row Styling
spec: Style a 'table' with a 'thead' containing 'th' (Header 1, Header 2) and a 'tbody' containing two 'tr' with 'td' (Data 1, Data 2). The table should have a 1px solid #CCCCCC border. The th elements should have a background #F8F8F8 and padding 10px. The td elements should have padding 8px. Alternate rows (tbody tr:nth-child(even)) should have a background #F0F0F0.

title: Chat Bubble (Incoming)
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'chat-bubble incoming'. Inside, a 'p' (Hello there!). The chat-bubble should have a background of #E2E2E2, padding 10px 15px, border-radius 15px 15px 15px 0, max-width 70%, and align to the left. The text color should be #333333.

title: Chat Bubble (Outgoing)
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'chat-bubble outgoing'. Inside, a 'p' (I'm good, thanks!). The chat-bubble should have a background of #007BFF, padding 10px 15px, border-radius 15px 15px 0 15px, max-width 70%, and align to the right using margin-left auto. The text color should be #FFFFFF.

title: Keyboard Shortcut Display
spec: Design a 'span' with class 'kbd'. It contains text 'Ctrl + C'. The kbd element should have a background of #EEEEEE, border of 1px solid #BBBBBB, padding 3px 6px, border-radius 3px, font-family monospace, and font-size 0.9em.

title: Video Thumbnail
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'video-thumbnail'. Inside, an 'img' (video.jpg) and a 'div' with class 'play-icon' (e.g., '▶'). The thumbnail should be positioned relative. The play-icon should be positioned absolute in the center, a large white triangle on a semi-transparent black circle, and font-size 2em.

title: Notification Dot
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'icon-wrapper'. Inside, an 'i' (e.g., a bell icon) and a 'span' with class 'notification-dot'. The icon-wrapper should be positioned relative. The notification-dot should be positioned absolute (e.g., top-right of icon), a small red circle (8px, background #DC3545, border-radius 50%), and display block.

title: Accordion Header
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'accordion-header'. Inside, an 'h4' (Section Title) and a 'span' (▼). The header should have a background of #F8F9FA, border-bottom 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, and display flex with space-between and align-items center. The span should be #666666.

title: Horizontal Rule with Text
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'separator'. Inside, a 'span' (OR). The separator should have a top and bottom border (1px solid #DDDDDD). The span should be positioned absolute, have a background of #FFFFFF, padding 0 10px, and text color #777777, effectively 'cutting' the line.

title: Empty State Message
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'empty-state'. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., empty-folder.png) and a 'p' (No items found.). The empty-state should be text-align center, have a padding of 30px, and a border of 1px dashed #CCCCCC. The image should be 80px wide. The p should be #666666.

title: Checkmark List
spec: Create a 'ul' with class 'checkmark-list'. It contains three 'li' items (Feature 1, Feature 2, Feature 3). Each li should have a checkmark icon (e.g., '✓') as a pseudo-element before the text. The checkmark should be green (#28A745) and the text black (#333333).

title: Rating Stars
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'rating'. It contains five 'span' elements, each with a star character (★). The stars should be gold (#FFC107) for the first three, and grey (#DDDDDD) for the remaining two (representing a 3-star rating).

title: Scroll-to-Top Button
spec: Create a 'button' with id 'scroll-top'. It contains an arrow icon (▲). The button should be fixed to the bottom-right of the viewport, have a background #007BFF, text #FFFFFF, border-radius 50%, 50px width/height, and a box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2). Initially hidden, appears on scroll.

title: Segmented Control Item
spec: Design an 'a' element with class 'segment-item' and text 'Option 1'. It should have a border of 1px solid #007BFF, padding 8px 15px, text color #007BFF, and border-radius (e.g., for left/right ends of a group). For an active item, the background should be #007BFF and text #FFFFFF.

title: File Upload Dropzone
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'dropzone'. Inside, a 'p' (Drag & drop files here or click to upload). The dropzone should have a border of 2px dashed #007BFF, background #F0F8FF, padding 30px, text-align center, and text color #007BFF. On hover, the border should become solid.

title: Skill Bar
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'skill-bar-container'. Inside, a 'div' with class 'skill-bar-fill'. The container should have a background #E0E0E0, height 15px, and border-radius 8px. The fill should have a background #28A745, height 100%, and a width of 75% (example value), also border-radius 8px.

title: Recipe Ingredient List
spec: Create a 'ul' with class 'ingredients'. It contains three 'li' items (1 cup flour, 2 eggs, 1/2 tsp salt). Each li should have a bullet point, padding 5px, and a bottom border of 1px dotted #DDDDDD. Text color should be #444444.

title: Social Media Icon Link
spec: Design an 'a' element with class 'social-icon' and an 'i' (e.g., a Font Awesome icon class like 'fa fa-facebook'). The link should be a circle (e.g., 40px, border-radius 50%), have a background of #3B5998, text color #FFFFFF, and text-align center with line-height for vertical centering. On hover, the background should darken slightly.

title: Event Card
spec: Create an 'event-card' div. Inside, an 'h3' (Event Title), a 'p' with class 'date' (Date: Jan 1, 2024), and a 'p' with class 'location' (Location: City Hall). The event-card should have a background of #FFFFFF, border 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, and border-radius 8px. The date should be bold and #007BFF. The location should be #6C757D.

title: Input with Addon
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'input-group'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'addon' (e.g., '@') and an 'input' of type text. The input-group should display flex. The addon should have a background #E9ECEF, border 1px solid #CED4DA, padding 8px 12px, border-right: none. The input should have a 1px solid #CED4DA border, padding 8px, and border-left: none. Round the corners appropriately for a combined look.

title: Countdown Timer Digit
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'timer-digit'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'value' (e.g., '05') and a 'span' with class 'label' (e.g., 'Days'). The timer-digit should have a background #343A40, text-align center, padding 10px, and border-radius 5px. The value should be large (font-size 2.5em) and #FFFFFF. The label should be smaller (font-size 0.8em) and #AAAAAA.

title: Scrollable Content Area
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'scrollable-area'. Inside, a 'p' with 10-15 lines of lorem ipsum text. The scrollable-area should have a fixed height (e.g., 200px), a border of 1px solid #DDDDDD, padding 10px, and overflow-y: scroll. The text color should be #333333.

title: Highlight Box
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'highlight-box'. Inside, an 'h3' (Important Note) and a 'p' (This is a highlighted piece of information.). The highlight-box should have a background of #FFF3CD, border-left 5px solid #FFC107, padding 15px, and border-radius 4px. The h3 should be #856404.

title: Step Indicator
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'step'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'step-number' (e.g., '1') and a 'p' (Step Description). The step should have display flex and align-items center. The step-number should be a circle (e.g., 30px, background #007BFF, text #FFFFFF, border-radius 50%, text-align center, line-height 30px) with 10px right margin. The p should be #333333.

title: File List Item
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'file-item'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'file-icon' (e.g., '🖹') and a 'a' (document.pdf). The file-item should have padding 8px, border-bottom 1px solid #EEEEEE, and display flex with align-items center. The file-icon should be #6C757D and 10px right margin. The 'a' should be #007BFF with no underline.

title: Coupon Code Box
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'coupon-box'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'code' (e.g., 'SAVE10') and a 'button' (Copy). The coupon-box should have a border of 2px dashed #28A745, background #D4EDDA, padding 10px, display flex, and justify-content space-between. The code should be bold and #155724. The button should have background #28A745 and text #FFFFFF.

title: User Permissions List
spec: Create a 'ul' with class 'permissions-list'. It contains three 'li' items (Read, Write, Delete). Each li should have a checkbox input before its text. The text color should be #333333 and li padding 5px.

title: Image Grid Item
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'grid-item'. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., grid-pic.jpg) and a 'div' with class 'title' (Image Title). The grid-item should have a border 1px solid #DDDDDD, overflow hidden, and position relative. The image should be 100% width. The title should be positioned absolute at the bottom, have a background rgba(0,0,0,0.7), padding 5px, text #FFFFFF, and 100% width.

title: Minimal Blog Post Preview
spec: Create a blog post preview. It has a `div` with class `post-preview`. Inside, there's an `h3` with class `post-title`, a `p` with class `post-excerpt`, and a `span` with class `post-date`. The `post-preview` should have a light grey background (#f8f8f8), 15px padding, and a 1px solid light grey border (#e0e0e0). The `post-title` should be bold, 1.2em font size, and color #333. The `post-excerpt` should have font size 0.9em and color #666. The `post-date` should be italic, 0.8em font size, and color #999, aligned to the right.

title: Contact Form Fieldset
spec: Design a contact form fieldset. Use a `fieldset` with id `contact-info`. Inside, there's a `legend` and two `div`s, each containing a `label` and an `input` (one for 'Name', one for 'Email'). The `fieldset` should have a 2px dotted border in #ccc and 20px padding. The `legend` should have a background of #eee, 10px padding, and text color #555. `label`s should be bold and display as block. `input` fields should have a 1px solid border #ddd, 8px padding, and a width of 250px.

title: Product Feature Grid Item
spec: Style a single product feature item for a grid. It consists of a `div` with class `feature-item`. Inside, there's an `i` (for icon) with class `feature-icon`, an `h4` with class `feature-title`, and a `p` with class `feature-description`. The `feature-item` should have 20px padding, a light blue background (#e9f7fe), and a 1px solid border (#c0e0f9). The `feature-icon` should be 3em, color #007bff, and centered. `feature-title` should be bold, 1.1em, color #333. `feature-description` should be 0.9em, color #666.

title: Dashboard Widget Header
spec: Create a dashboard widget header. Use a `div` with class `widget-header`. Inside, there's an `h2` with class `widget-title` and a `span` with class `widget-action-icon`. The `widget-header` should have a dark grey background (#333), white text (#fff), 15px padding, and be flex-aligned to space-between. The `widget-title` should be 1.1em, bold. The `widget-action-icon` should be 0.9em, color #bbb, and have a pointer cursor.

title: Shopping Cart Item
spec: Style a single item in a shopping cart. It's a `div` with class `cart-item`. Inside, there's an `img` with class `item-thumbnail`, a `div` with class `item-details` containing an `h4` (item name) and `span` (item price), and a `button` with class `remove-item`. The `cart-item` should have a white background, 15px padding, and a 1px solid bottom border (#eee). `item-thumbnail` should be 60px by 60px, float left, and have 10px right margin. `item-details` should have `h4` as 1em bold, `span` as 0.9em color #888. `remove-item` button should be small, red (#dc3545) with white text, 5px padding.

title: Article Tag List
spec: Display a list of tags for an article. Use a `div` with class `tag-list`. Inside, there are multiple `span` elements with class `tag`. The `tag-list` should have a small top margin. Each `tag` should have a light blue background (#e0f7fa), dark blue text (#00796b), 8px padding (vertical 4px, horizontal 8px), a 4px border-radius, and display as inline-block with a 5px right margin.

title: Quick Stats Box
spec: Create a quick statistics display. Use a `div` with class `stat-box`. Inside, there's a `p` with class `stat-value` and another `p` with class `stat-label`. The `stat-box` should have a light background (#f0f8ff), 20px padding, a 1px solid border (#d0e0ff), and be text-aligned center. The `stat-value` should be bold, 2em font size, and color #0056b3. The `stat-label` should be 0.9em font size and color #666.

title: Language Selector
spec: Style a simple language selector. It's a `div` with class `lang-selector`. Inside, there are multiple `a` tags with class `lang-option`. The `lang-selector` should have a subtle bottom border (#eee) and 5px bottom padding. Each `lang-option` should be grey (#666), 0.9em, have 5px horizontal padding, and a right border of 1px solid #ccc (except the last one). On hover, text color should be #007bff.

title: Key-Value Pair Display
spec: Present data as key-value pairs. Use a `div` with class `data-list`. Inside, there are several `div`s, each with class `data-row`. Each `data-row` contains a `span` with class `data-key` and a `span` with class `data-value`. The `data-list` should have 1px solid #eee bottom border. Each `data-row` should have 8px vertical padding. `data-key` should be bold, color #555, and occupy 30% width. `data-value` should be color #333 and occupy 70% width. Both spans should display as inline-block.

title: User Menu Link
spec: Style a single link for a user menu. It's an `a` tag with class `menu-link`. Inside, there's an `i` for an icon and a `span` for the text. The `menu-link` should display as a block, have 10px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, text color #333, and no underline. The icon should be 1.2em and have 10px right margin. On hover, the background should be light grey (#f0f0f0) and text color #007bff.

title: Recipe Step Item
spec: Design a single step in a recipe. It's a `li` with class `recipe-step`. Inside, there's a `span` with class `step-number` and a `p` with class `step-description`. The `recipe-step` should have 10px bottom margin and a dotted bottom border (#ddd). The `step-number` should be a circular badge (25px width/height, #007bff background, white text, centered, bold, 50% border-radius). The `step-description` should be 0.95em, color #444, and left-aligned next to the number.

title: Download Button with Icon
spec: Style a download button that includes an icon. It's an `a` tag with class `download-btn`. Inside, there's an `i` for the icon and a `span` for the text 'Download File'. The `download-btn` should have a green background (#28a745), white text, 12px vertical and 20px horizontal padding, 5px border-radius, no underline, and display inline-flex with items centered. The icon should have 8px right margin. On hover, background should darken to #218838.

title: Comment Reply Link
spec: Style a 'Reply' link for a comment section. It's an `a` tag with class `reply-link`. It should be small (0.8em), grey text (#6c757d), no underline, and have a small left margin. On hover, text color should be #007bff and underline appears.

title: System Message (Success)
spec: Create a success message box. It's a `div` with class `success-message`. Inside, there's an `i` for a checkmark icon and a `p` for the message text. The `success-message` should have a light green background (#d4edda), green border (#28a745), green text (#155724), 15px padding, 5px border-radius, and display as flex with items centered. The icon should have 10px right margin and be 1.2em.

title: Quantity Selector
spec: Design a quantity selector. It's a `div` with class `quantity-selector`. Inside, there are two `button`s (one for '-' and one for '+') and an `input` with type 'number' in between. The `quantity-selector` should display as inline-flex. The `button`s should have a light grey background (#eee), 1px solid border (#ccc), 8px padding, and same width/height (e.g., 30px). The `input` should be text-aligned center, 1px solid border (#ccc), 8px padding, and a fixed width (e.g., 40px), no spin buttons.

title: Related Post Thumbnail
spec: Style a thumbnail for a related blog post. It's a `div` with class `related-post`. Inside, there's an `img` with class `post-thumb` and an `h5` with class `post-title`. The `related-post` should display as flex. The `post-thumb` should be 60px by 60px, have a small right margin, and 3px border-radius. The `post-title` should be 0.9em, color #333, and limited to two lines (ellipsis for overflow).

title: Search Input with Button
spec: Create a search input field with an appended button. It's a `div` with class `search-bar`. Inside, there's an `input` with class `search-input` and a `button` with class `search-btn`. The `search-bar` should display as flex. The `search-input` should have 1px solid border (#ccc), 10px padding, and take up available space. The `search-btn` should have a blue background (#007bff), white text, 10px padding, and no border. Round the corners of the input on the left and button on the right.

title: Avatar Group Item
spec: Style an item for an avatar group display. It's an `img` with class `avatar-circle`. The `avatar-circle` should be 40px by 40px, have a 50% border-radius, and a 2px solid white border. When stacked, each avatar should overlap the previous one by 10px (using negative margin).

title: Breadcrumb Link
spec: Style a single link within a breadcrumb navigation. It's an `a` tag with class `breadcrumb-item`. It should have grey text (#666), 0.9em font size, no underline. After each item (except the last), add a ' / ' separator with a slightly lighter color (#aaa).

title: Filter Chip
spec: Design a filter chip component. It's a `span` with class `filter-chip`. It should have a light blue background (#e0f7fa), dark blue text (#00796b), 5px vertical and 10px horizontal padding, 15px border-radius, display as inline-flex with items centered, and a small right margin. Add a small 'x' icon (e.g., `×`) that appears on hover, acting as a close button.

title: Code Block Line Number
spec: Style a line number within a code block. It's a `span` with class `line-number`. It should have a light grey background (#f0f0f0), dark grey text (#999), 5px horizontal padding, fixed width (e.g., 30px), text-align right, and display as inline-block. It should be positioned to the left of the actual code line.

title: Sidebar Menu Heading
spec: Style a heading for a section in a sidebar menu. It's an `h4` with class `menu-section-heading`. It should be uppercase, 0.8em font size, light grey text (#aaa), bold, and have 15px top and 5px bottom padding.

title: Alert Icon Container
spec: Create a container for an alert icon. It's a `div` with class `alert-icon-wrapper`. Inside, there's an `i` tag. The `alert-icon-wrapper` should be a circle (e.g., 40px width/height), red background (#dc3545), white text, centered icon, 50% border-radius. The icon (`i`) should be 1.5em.

title: Calendar Day Cell
spec: Style a single day cell in a calendar. It's a `div` with class `calendar-day`. It should have a 1px solid light grey border (#eee), 10px padding, and a minimum height (e.g., 80px). The day number (`span` with class `day-number`) should be aligned to the top-right, bold, and 1.1em. On hover, the background should be slightly darker (#f5f5f5).

title: Image Placeholder
spec: Design a generic image placeholder. It's a `div` with class `img-placeholder`. It should have a light grey background (#eee), a dashed border (2px, #ccc), be text-aligned center, and contain a small text 'Image' (color #999) and a small icon (`i`). The placeholder should have a fixed width and height (e.g., 100px by 100px), with the text and icon vertically and horizontally centered.

title: User Activity Feed Item
spec: Style a single item in a user activity feed. It's a `li` with class `activity-item`. Inside, there's an `img` (user avatar), a `span` (username), and a `p` (activity description). The `activity-item` should have 10px vertical padding and a subtle bottom border (#f5f5f5). The avatar should be 30px round with 5px right margin. Username should be bold, description 0.9em and color #666. Use flexbox for layout.

title: Dashboard Metric Card
spec: Create a card displaying a single dashboard metric. It's a `div` with class `metric-card`. Inside, there's an `h3` (metric title), a `p` (metric value), and a `span` (metric unit). The `metric-card` should have a white background, 20px padding, a subtle box-shadow, and 5px border-radius. The `metric-title` should be 0.9em, uppercase, color #888. The `metric-value` should be 2.5em, bold, color #333. The `metric-unit` should be 0.8em, color #666.

title: Collapsible Section Trigger
spec: Style the trigger for a collapsible section. It's a `button` with class `collapse-trigger`. Inside, there's a `span` for the title and an `i` for an arrow icon. The `collapse-trigger` should have a light grey background (#f8f8f8), 12px padding, 1px solid border (#eee), full width, text-align left, and a pointer cursor. The title should be bold. The arrow icon should be on the right, rotate 90deg when the section is open (add class `is-open` to the button).

title: Upload Progress Bar Segment
spec: Style a segment of an upload progress bar. It's a `div` with class `progress-segment`. It should have a height of 10px, a green background (#28a745), and a small border-radius on its ends if it's the first or last segment. Use `width` to represent progress percentage.

title: Tooltip Bubble
spec: Design a tooltip bubble. It's a `span` with class `tooltip`. It should have a dark background (#333), white text, 8px padding, 4px border-radius, and be positioned absolutely near its trigger. Add a small triangle 'arrow' pointing downwards from its bottom center.

title: Inline Code Highlight
spec: Style a short inline code snippet. It's a `code` element. It should have a very light grey background (#f5f5f5), a dark grey text color (#c7254e), 2px vertical and 4px horizontal padding, and a 3px border-radius. Use a monospace font.

title: Form Error Message
spec: Style a validation error message for a form field. It's a `p` with class `error-message`. It should have red text (#dc3545), 0.85em font size, and 5px top margin. It should appear below the invalid input field.

title: Card Footer Actions
spec: Design a footer for a card containing action buttons. It's a `div` with class `card-actions`. Inside, there are several `a` or `button` elements with class `action-btn`. The `card-actions` should have a light grey top border (#eee) and 15px top padding. Each `action-btn` should be a small, secondary-style button (e.g., light blue background #007bff, white text, 8px padding, no border, 4px border-radius, slight right margin).

title: Circular Progress Ring
spec: Create a circular progress ring. It's a `div` with class `progress-ring-container`. Inside, there's a `div` with class `progress-ring-fill` (for the actual progress) and a `span` with class `progress-text` (for percentage). The `progress-ring-container` should be a fixed size circle (e.g., 80px diameter), with a light grey border as the track. The `progress-ring-fill` should be styled using `border` on a half-circle or `conic-gradient` to represent progress. The `progress-text` should be centered within the ring, bold, 1.2em.

title: File Attachment Display
spec: Style how a file attachment is displayed. It's a `div` with class `file-attachment`. Inside, there's an `i` (file icon), a `span` (filename), and another `i` (remove icon). The `file-attachment` should have a light background (#f8f9fa), a dashed border (#dee2e6), 10px padding, and display as inline-flex with items centered. The file icon should be blue (#007bff) and have 8px right margin. Filename should be 0.9em. Remove icon should be small, red, and have a pointer cursor.

title: Task List Item (Completed)
spec: Style a completed task list item. It's a `li` with class `task-done`. Inside, there's a `span` with class `task-text` and an `i` for a checkmark icon. The `task-done` should have a light grey background (#f0f0f0), light grey text (#999), and a line-through on the `task-text`. The checkmark icon should be green (#28a745) and positioned to the left of the text.

title: Price Label with Currency
spec: Display a price with its currency. It's a `span` with class `price-label`. Inside, there's a `span` for currency (`currency-symbol`) and a `span` for the amount (`price-amount`). The `price-label` should be bold. The `currency-symbol` should be smaller (0.8em) and slightly raised. The `price-amount` should be larger (1.5em) and prominent.

title: List Group Item (Active)
spec: Style an active item in a list group. It's an `a` tag with class `list-group-item active`. It should have a primary blue background (#007bff), white text, bold font, and 12px vertical and 15px horizontal padding. It should also have a 1px solid blue border (#007bff). On hover, it should keep the active style.

title: Dropdown Menu Separator
spec: Create a visual separator for a dropdown menu. It's a `div` with class `dropdown-divider`. It should be a 1px solid light grey line (#eee) with 8px vertical margin.

title: Interactive Map Marker
spec: Design an interactive map marker. It's a `div` with class `map-marker`. Inside, there's an `i` for an icon. The `map-marker` should be a red circle (30px diameter, #dc3545 background, white text, 50% border-radius), centered icon (1.2em), and have a subtle drop shadow. On hover, it should scale up slightly and change background to a darker red (#c82333).

title: Tab Navigation Item
spec: Style a single tab in a tab navigation. It's an `a` tag with class `tab-item`. It should have 10px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, grey text (#666), no underline, and a 1px solid bottom border (#eee). When active (class `active`), it should have a blue bottom border (3px, #007bff) and bolder text. On hover, text color should be #007bff.

title: Table Header Cell
spec: Style a header cell in a data table. It's a `th` element. It should have a light grey background (#f8f8f8), dark grey text (#333), bold font, 10px padding, and a 1px solid bottom border (#ddd). Text should be uppercase and 0.9em.

title: Badge with Icon
spec: Create a badge that includes an icon. It's a `span` with class `icon-badge`. Inside, there's an `i` for the icon and a `span` for the text. The `icon-badge` should have a primary blue background (#007bff), white text, 4px vertical and 8px horizontal padding, 12px border-radius, and display as inline-flex with items centered. The icon should have 5px right margin.

title: Media Object Thumbnail
spec: Style a thumbnail for a media object (like an article or comment avatar). It's an `img` with class `media-thumb`. It should be 64px by 64px, have a 2px solid light grey border (#eee), and 5px border-radius. It should float left with 15px right margin.

title: Discount Label
spec: Design a discount label for a product. It's a `span` with class `discount-label`. It should have a vibrant red background (#dc3545), white text, 5px vertical and 8px horizontal padding, 3px border-radius, and be slightly rotated (-5deg) to appear dynamic.

title: Time Remaining Display
spec: Style a 'time remaining' display. It's a `div` with class `time-remaining`. Inside, there's a `span` for the numeric value (`time-value`) and a `span` for the unit (`time-unit`). The `time-remaining` should be inline-block. The `time-value` should be large (2em), bold. The `time-unit` should be smaller (0.8em), grey (#666), and positioned below the value.

title: Dropdown Toggle Button
spec: Style a button that acts as a dropdown toggle. It's a `button` with class `dropdown-toggle`. It should have a light grey background (#f0f0f0), dark grey text (#333), 10px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, 4px border-radius, and include a small caret icon (e.g., Unicode character or SVG) to its right. On hover, background should darken slightly.

title: Share Button Group
spec: Style a group of social share buttons. It's a `div` with class `share-buttons`. Inside, there are multiple `a` tags with class `share-btn`. The `share-buttons` should display as flex. Each `share-btn` should be a small circle (35px diameter), have a distinct brand color background (e.g., Facebook blue #3b5998), white icon, 50% border-radius, and 5px right margin. On hover, scale up slightly.

title: Text Input with Prefix
spec: Design a text input field with a decorative prefix. It's a `div` with class `input-group`. Inside, there's a `span` with class `input-prefix` and an `input` with class `form-input`. The `input-group` should display as flex. The `input-prefix` should have a light grey background (#e9ecef), 1px solid border (#ced4da), 10px padding, and round left corners. The `form-input` should have 1px solid border (#ced4da), 10px padding, and round right corners, with no outline on focus.

title: Timeline Event Marker
spec: Style a marker for an event on a timeline. It's a `div` with class `timeline-marker`. It should be a small circle (15px diameter), primary blue background (#007bff), 50% border-radius, and positioned absolutely along a vertical line. Add a subtle pulsing animation.

title: Subscription Tier Header
spec: Design the header for a subscription tier in a pricing table. It's a `div` with class `tier-header`. Inside, there's an `h3` (tier name) and a `p` (tagline). The `tier-header` should have a dark background (#343a40), white text, 20px padding, and text-align center. The `h3` should be 1.5em, bold. The `p` should be 0.9em, color #bbb.

title: User Dashboard Card
spec: Create a general-purpose card for a user dashboard. It's a `div` with class `dashboard-card`. Inside, there's an `h2` (card title) and a `div` with class `card-content`. The `dashboard-card` should have a white background, 20px padding, 8px border-radius, and a subtle box-shadow. The `card-title` should be 1.2em, bold, color #333, with a 10px bottom margin and a light grey bottom border (#eee).

title: Horizontal Navigation Link
spec: Style a single link in a horizontal navigation menu. It's an `a` tag with class `nav-item`. It should have 10px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, dark grey text (#333), no underline, and display as inline-block. On hover, background should be light grey (#f8f8f8) and text color #007bff.

title: Image with Caption Block
spec: Style an image with its caption. It's a `figure` element. Inside, there's an `img` and a `figcaption`. The `figure` should have a 1px solid light grey border (#eee) and 10px padding. The `img` should be full width of its container. The `figcaption` should be 0.85em, italic, color #777, and centered, with 10px top margin.

title: File Browser Item
spec: Style an item in a file browser (e.g., a file or folder). It's a `div` with class `file-item`. Inside, there's an `i` (icon) and a `span` (name). The `file-item` should display as flex, with items centered, and have 8px vertical padding. The icon should be 1.2em, blue (#007bff), and have 10px right margin. The name should be 0.95em. On hover, background should be light blue (#e9f7fe).

title: Coupon Code Input
spec: Design an input field specifically for coupon codes. It's a `div` with class `coupon-input-wrapper`. Inside, there's an `input` with class `coupon-code-input` and a `button` with class `apply-coupon-btn`. The `coupon-input-wrapper` should display as flex. The `coupon-code-input` should have 1px dashed border (#ccc), 10px padding, and take up most width. The `apply-coupon-btn` should be small, green (#28a745) with white text, 10px padding, and 4px border-radius, with no border.

title: Notification Bell Icon
spec: Style a notification bell icon. It's an `i` element with class `notification-bell`. It should be 1.5em size, color #555, and have a `span` with class `badge` for the notification count. The `badge` should be a small red circle (18px diameter, #dc3545 background, white text, 50% border-radius, font-size 0.7em), positioned absolutely on the top-right of the bell, indicating count.

title: Sidebar Section Link
spec: Style a link within a sidebar section. It's an `a` tag with class `sidebar-link`. It should display as a block, have 8px vertical and 15px horizontal padding, grey text (#555), no underline. On hover, background should be light grey (#f0f0f0) and text color primary blue (#007bff). If `active` class is present, text should be bold and background blue (#e0f7fa).

title: User Bio Text
spec: Style a user's short biography text. It's a `p` with class `user-bio`. It should have a font size of 0.9em, line-height of 1.6, and text color #444. Limit to 3 lines with ellipsis if it overflows.

title: Pricing Feature List Item
spec: Style a single feature item in a pricing plan's feature list. It's a `li` with class `feature-item`. Inside, there's an `i` (checkmark or cross icon) and a `span` (feature text). The `feature-item` should have 8px vertical padding. The icon should be 1em, green (#28a745) for checkmark or grey (#6c757d) for cross, and have 8px right margin. The text should be 0.9em, color #333.

title: Navigation Menu Item

title: Feature Callout Box
spec: A div `div.feature-callout` with an `h4.feature-title` and a `p.feature-description`. The box has a #e6f7ff background, 10px solid #91d5ff left border, 15px padding, 5px border-radius. Title is #1890ff, 1.2em. Description is #333, 0.9em.

title: Pricing Card Feature
spec: A list item `li.feature-item` within a `ul.feature-list`. Each item contains a `span.check-icon` and `span.feature-text`. The check icon is green, 1em. Text is #555. Items have 5px bottom margin. Icon and text are inline-flex, vertically centered.

title: Dashboard Statistic
spec: A div `div.statistic-card` with an `h5.stat-label` and `p.stat-value`. The card has 10px padding, 1px solid #f0f0f0 border, 5px border-radius. Label is 0.8em, #999, uppercase. Value is 1.8em, bold, #333. Text is centered.

title: Event Card Title
spec: A div `div.event-card` with an `h3.event-title` and `span.event-date`. The card has 15px padding, 1px solid #e8e8e8 border, 8px border-radius. Title is 1.4em, bold, #222. Date is 0.9em, #888, italic. Title has 5px bottom margin.

title: Image Caption Overlay

title: Search Result Item
spec: A div `div.search-result` containing an `h3.result-title` and a `p.result-snippet`. The result has 10px bottom margin, 1px solid #f5f5f5 bottom border. Title is #007bff, 1.2em, no underline. Snippet is #555, 0.9em. Title has 5px bottom margin.

title: User Profile Avatar

title: Expandable Section Header
